newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom sale could start in September.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom sale could start in September.

text.p: The partial privatisation of telecommunications group France Telecom SA could start in September as soon as state envoy Michel Delebarre has handed over his report, an official source said on Thursday.
Prime Minister Lionel Jospin earlier this month instructed Delebarre to carry out a wide consultation of France Telecom staff and management before any decision is made.
"The process of opening the capital could be launched in September," the source said.

Delebarre has been asked to report back to the government before September 5. He has held talks with the main labour unions at France Telecom and on Wednesday said the staff wanted an end to the uncertainty surrounding the future of their company.
He said he did not consider a partial sale of France Telecom's capital to be a privatisation, to which many unions and the Communist Party are opposed.

Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said on July 18 that the state would keep a majority stake in the company, the same position held by the previous conservative government which had planned to sell 35 percent beginning in June.
